name: visual-prompt
description: Generate grounded, non-repetitive image prompts by default, with explicitly enabled video/music prompts, strict source anchors, parent-only generation, and fail-closed quality gates for Vietnamese xianxia/wuxia novel files; the batch driver may opt into isolated runner-level Pass-2 workers (VP_WORKERS) and may scope runs via VP_NO_VIDEO/VP_NO_MUSIC/VP_GLOB without changing the default serial run or the default workflow; --lean opt-in swaps the ten-section deep prompt for a five-section spec (Subject/Setting/Action/Style/Negative) whose mode is fixed by the user invocation, not the model; the auto scene band runs 120-300 images (a ~3h narration); the plan gate checks every declared total against its source — image and chapter counts recomputed from the chapter JSON, genre against genre.txt, per-chapter coverage against each chapter's share of the prose; lean Setting/Action are length-checked as each scene is written (8-word floor) so a stub field fails on the first scenes instead of as a duplicate flood at the end; the stop gate refuses to end a run whose .work has no chapters_qa.json or plan.hash, and scene-plan.md cannot be written before chapters_qa.json exists, so the pipeline cannot be skipped down to the scene plan; assemble_qa refuses to write a proofread that lost more than 15% of the source words, since chapters_qa.json is what every later gate measures against; under --lean, Style is checked as the series lock — one block repeated verbatim, since the repetition gate deliberately never compares it; a slow cloud read is retried rather than failing the step outright; assemble_qa refuses prose that still holds Chinese characters, the Style block must match references/style-catalog.md verbatim, and assemble_outputs merges the run's character rows back into the series bible; the house slang rule (đéo/đách -> éo, everything else left alone) is applied by assemble_qa rather than trusted to the QA step; a run whose scene files cleanup already merged proves itself from the deliverable and the authorship log instead of from files that are gone by design, and a bare Negative: list no longer reads as a content-safety hit; assemble_qa measures retention per chapter and checks that each chapter's last source paragraph survived, so one gutted chapter cannot hide behind a healthy total; the stop gate holds a run that has an accepted plan but has not started expanding, since a plan nothing expanded is an unfinished run
